The *Hetuduka, Sahetukaduka* (Patthana 24.1) is a canonical text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* within the *Abhidhamma Piṭaka*. It constitutes an analytical section treating conditional relations according to the combination of the root dyad (*hetuduka*) and the dyad of states accompanied by roots (*sahetukaduka*).
